from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import json
with sync_playwright() as pw:
    browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800})
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
    page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3100')
    page.wait_for_selector('.editor-line:nth-child(1223)')
    initial = page.locator('.editor-line').count()
    editor = page.locator('#editor')
    editor.click(position={"x": 180, "y": 12})
    page.keyboard.type('TEST')
    dirty = page.locator('#save-state').text_content()
    page.keyboard.press('Control+z')
    after_undo = page.locator('#save-state').text_content()
    page.locator('#find-input').fill('ALPHA-1200')
    page.locator('#find-next-button').click()
    match = page.locator('#match-state').text_content()
    cursor = page.locator('#cursor-state').text_content()
    page.locator('#history-button').click()
    page.wait_for_selector('.revision-item')
    revisions = page.locator('.revision-item').count()
    result = dict(initial=initial, dirty=dirty, afterUndo=after_undo, match=match, cursor=cursor, revisions=revisions, errors=errors)
    print(json.dumps(result))
    assert initial == 1223 and dirty == 'Unsaved changes' and after_undo == 'Saved' and match == '1 of 1' and revisions == 1 and not errors
    browser.close()
